WITH sla_breaches AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.severity, i.status, i.category, i.responsible_trade,
    i.assigned_to, i.assigned_at, i.description,
    floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.assigned_at))/86400)::int AS days_since_assigned,
    CASE i.severity
      WHEN 'urgent' THEN 2
      WHEN 'high'   THEN 5
      WHEN 'medium' THEN 14
      ELSE 30
    END AS sla_days
  FROM aftercare_incidents i
  WHERE i.status IN ('assigned', 'in_progress')
    AND i.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'breaches', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_overdue DESC) FROM (
    SELECT b.id::text AS incident_id, b.severity, b.status, b.category, b.responsible_trade,
      b.assigned_to, b.assigned_at, b.days_since_assigned, b.sla_days,
      (b.days_since_assigned - b.sla_days) AS days_overdue,
      substring(b.description for 100) AS desc_preview,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM sla_breaches b
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = b.project_id
    WHERE b.days_since_assigned > b.sla_days
    LIMIT 30
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'total_breaches', (SELECT count(*) FROM sla_breaches WHERE days_since_assigned > sla_days)::int,
  'sla_table', json_build_object(
    'urgent_days', 2, 'high_days', 5, 'medium_days', 14, 'low_days', 30
  )
) AS report;
